这篇文章是给准备在湾区签租房合同的人看的。很多人抢房时只盯着月租和入住日期，真正: This article is for people preparing to sign a Bay Area lease. When competing for a place, it's easy to focus only on rent and the move-in date. Problems often hide in details: deposit refunds, roommate changes, early move-out, and who handles repairs.
合同拿到手，第一步对照四项：地址、租期、月租和付款日期都写清楚了吗？和之前谈好的: When you get the lease, first check four things: are the address, term, rent and due date written out, and do they match what you agreed? If these are vague, the rest only gets harder to read.
房屋地址是否完整，房间号、车位、储物空间有没有写清楚。: Is the full address listed, including the unit, parking space, and storage area?
租期是固定租期还是 month-to-month，起止时间有没有写明。: Is it a fixed-term or month-to-month lease, and are the start and end dates clear?
月租金额、付款日期、迟付处理方式有没有说明。: Are monthly rent, the due date, and late-payment terms stated?
押金、预留金、其他费用分别是什么性质，有没有写在同一份文件里。: Clarify what the deposit, holding payment, and other charges each represent, and whether they are documented together.
除了月租，还要算总成本: Look past the rent to the total cost
湾区不少房子月租看起来还行，住进去才发现停车、水电网、垃圾、公共区域、洗衣、宠物: Plenty of Bay Area places look affordable until you add parking, utilities and internet, trash, common areas, laundry, pets and move-in or move-out fees. Before signing, list every fixed monthly cost with its amount. Deposits have a cap: the California DOJ says that after July 1, 2024, most landlords may take at most one month’s rent as a security deposit.
停车位是不是另外收费，访客停车是否方便。: Whether parking costs extra and whether visitor parking is convenient.
水、电、燃气、网络、垃圾是谁付，怎么算。: Who pays for water, electricity, gas, internet, and trash, and how are charges calculated?
如果是 apartment，是否有 move-in 预约、门禁、包裹或公共设施使: For an apartment, check move-in bookings, entry access, packages, and shared-facility rules.
合租情况下，公共费用是均摊还是按房间分。: In shared housing, are common expenses split equally or by room?
提前搬走、续租、转租这些条款最容易被忽略: Early move-out, renewal, and subletting clauses are easy to overlook
很多人签的时候觉得先住进去再说，后面遇到换工作、室友搬走、想换城市时，才发现限制: People often sign with the idea of moving in first, only to discover restrictions later when changing jobs, losing a roommate, or wanting to move cities. Pay attention to leaving before a fixed term ends, finding a replacement tenant, subletting, renewal after the term, and whether roommate changes require fresh approval.
维修责任和入住状态要问清楚: Clarify repair responsibilities and move-in condition
合同里维修、报修、清洁和家电责任写得模糊，入住后最容易扯皮。签约前问清哪些由房东: Vague clauses on repairs, repair requests, cleaning and appliances cause the most arguments after move-in. Before signing, ask which jobs belong to the landlord or manager and which to you, and photograph the unit’s condition on move-in day.
把你最在意的三件事单独写下来，比如停车、提前搬走、能不能加室友。签字前，把这三件: Write down your three biggest priorities, such as parking, early departure, or adding a roommate. Before signing, get a clear answer on each of the three.
谁是主租人，谁直接写进合同。: Who is the primary tenant, and whose names are on the lease?
押金最后退给谁，室友之间怎么分。: Who receives the returned deposit, and how is it divided among roommates?
有人中途搬走时，新室友如何接替。: How will a replacement roommate take over if someone leaves early?
如果其中一人晚交租，是否会影响全屋。: Whether one person's late rent affects the whole household.
别先翻到签字页：先对照地址、租期、月租和付款日期。: Don’t jump to the signature page: check the address, term, rent and due date first.
别靠印象估总成本，每月固定支出逐项列出。: Don’t estimate the total cost from memory; list each fixed monthly cost.
最在意的三件事没讲清楚，别被“先签再说”推着签字。: If your three priorities are still unclear, don’t let “sign now, sort it out later” push you into signing.
